description:
Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/NeuroticiIndex.csv' in Jamovi. Create two new computed variables:
1. 'N1_Binary': Formula 'IF(N1 > 3, 1, 0)'
2. 'N2_Binary': Formula 'IF(N2 > 3, 1, 0)'

Set the Measure Type for both new variables to 'Nominal'.

Perform a McNemar's test (Paired Samples) to compare the proportion of high scores (>3) between 'N1_Binary' and 'N2_Binary'.

Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/NeuroticismMcNemar.omv'.

Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/mcnemar_results.txt' containing the p-value of the McNemar test in the format: 'p_value: 0.123'.
